name: Fulfilment
description: Getting an order to the shopper. An order may leave in more than one shipment, and a shipment line says how much of which order line each one carries. The promise date is a datetime on the shipment.

entities.name: Shipment
entities.description: Goods sent for an order. One order can be split across several shipments; which lines each carries is on its shipment lines.

attributes.name: promisedAt
attributes.description: When the shipment is promised. A deadline is a datetime attribute.

attributes.name: trackingNumber
attributes.description: The carrier's tracking number, once the shipment has one.

entities.name: Shipment line
entities.description: A shipment line is an entity because the connection between a shipment and an order line carries a quantity: a split shipment covers some of an order's lines, or part of one. A relationship cannot hold that quantity.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: How many units of the order line this shipment carries.

attributes.name: line
attributes.description: The order line covered. An order's lines are the lines of the cart it was built from.

relationships.name: fulfils
relationships.description: A shipment fulfils an order. An order may have several.

relationships.name: includes
relationships.description: A shipment includes its shipment lines.

relationships.name: covers
relationships.description: A shipment line covers one order line. The quantity stays on the shipment line, not on this edge.
